title: Coordinate monotonicity after polarization
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $f$ be a function from the $n$-dimensional sign cube to $\{-1,1\}$, and let $i$ be a coordinate. The coordinate polarization of $f$ in coordinate $i$ is monotone in coordinate $i$: for every input $x$, its value at the point obtained from $x$ by setting coordinate $i$ to $-1$ is at most its value at the point obtained by setting coordinate $i$ to $1$.
